# Historical config fixtures

Each YAML file is copied byte for byte from the listed milestone endpoint commit.
Configs whose store directory exists only in their runtime environment are in `../compat-store/`.
The fixture file name matches its original path under `examples/`.
Historical mock-provider examples are excluded from compatibility checks because the shipped provider was removed.

Source commit: `61f3a53`.
